page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by x86_64 architecture Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. Configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM, the system delivers a balanced vCPU-to-memory ratio of 1:4 with 4.0 GB of memory per core. The virtualized instance operates under a KVM hypervisor.

This server type lacks bundled local storage and GPU hardware accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached block storage for persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a 30 Gbps baseline bandwidth interface. The baseline network capacity accommodates communication-intensive distributed tasks, though primary storage performance depends on the configuration of attached cloud volumes.

Given its 64 dedicated vCPUs and 256 GB RAM capacity paired with 30 Gbps network bandwidth, the ecs.g5ne.16xlarge provides high resource density for enterprise applications, medium-to-large relational databases, web serving, and CI/CD pipelines. Its high network throughput and dedicated vCPU allocation offer stable computing capability for parallelized processing tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose cloud server instance featuring 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at 2.5 GHz. It includes 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, the instance provides 30 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. It contains no local storage or dedicated GPU acceleration, requiring external network-attached volumes for data persistence. With substantial CPU core density and high network throughput, the ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is structured for multi-threaded enterprise workloads, medium-scale database deployments, web server fleets, and distributed CI/CD build environments.
